decks.notes: The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with low-cost creatures and enchantments to quickly buff them up. By playing a large number of small creatures and using auras like Ethereal Armor and Hyena Umbra, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful offense. Spirit Link and Benevolent Blessing provide some protection for key creatures, while Secluded Steppe helps with card draw to maintain momentum. The deck?s strategy centers around building a strong board presence early on and using auras to maximize the damage output of its creatures.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and efficiently play low-cost creatures and spells to get early damage on the opponent while controlling the board with removal and graveyard hate. The deck aims to maintain a steady stream of aggression with cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Glint Hawk, while also keeping the opponent's resources in check with cards like Relic of Progenitus. The mana base is designed to support a fast and consistent early game, allowing the deck to apply pressure and finish off the opponent quickly.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying low-cost creatures and powerful removal spells to apply early pressure and control the board. By utilizing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Seeker of the Way, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Journey to Nowhere, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays. Additionally, the inclusion of artifact lands and artifact-themed cards like Glint Hawk and Galvanic Blast provides additional value and flexibility. The overall strategy is to maintain a fast-paced tempo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl, allowing for early game aggression with creatures like Arbor Elf and Annoyed Altisaur. By consistently ramping up mana, the deck can quickly deploy high-impact threats like Avenging Hunter and Generous Ent, overwhelming opponents with a combination of efficient creatures and powerful removal spells like Skred and Thermokarst. The deck's overall strategy is to apply pressure from the start and maintain board control to secure a swift victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a strong board presence through aggressive plays and efficient removal spells, overwhelming the opponent with direct damage and powerful creatures. By utilizing low-cost spells and creatures, as well as mana acceleration with Lotus Petal, the deck aims to maintain a fast pace and apply constant pressure on the opponent, ultimately leading to a swift victory through continuous aggression and smart resource management.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overrun the opponent with a swarm of low-cost aggressive creatures and direct burn spells. By maximizing early game damage output with cards like Goblin Bushwhacker and Monastery Swiftspear, while also maintaining a consistent source of burn damage through cards like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, this deck aims to rapidly deplete the opponent's life total before they can establish a strong defense. Additionally, cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Voldaren Epicure provide additional value and synergy to keep the pressure on.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle utilizing low-cost spells and creatures. The deck includes a variety of counterspells and card draw options to control the pace of the game, while also relying on powerful creatures like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent to apply pressure on the opponent. By maintaining a high tempo and disrupting the opponent's strategy, the deck aims to secure a quick victory by outpacing and outmaneuvering the opponent.

This pauper 1 vs 1 control deck focuses on utilizing the Ephemerate spell to gain value from creatures with enter the battlefield effects such as Mulldrifter. By bouncing creatures like Sea Gate Oracle and Archaeomancer with Ephemerate, the deck aims to generate card advantage and control the game with counterspells like Prohibit and Remove Soul. The inclusion of Sunscape Familiar reduces the cost of white and blue spells, allowing for more efficient casting. With card draw from Deep Analysis and filtering from Preordain, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast its opponents in a slower, more grindy matchup.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to outvalue the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's plans while steadily building resources and eventually closing out the game with threats like Gurmag Angler and Murmuring Mystic. The deck also includes some unique cards like Unexpected Fangs and Tolarian Terror to provide additional utility and flexibility in different situations. It leverages a mix of efficient spells and powerful creatures to dominate the battlefield and secure victory through attrition and strategic play.

The main focus of the deck is to control the game early on with counter spells and disruption, while also utilizing card draw and discard effects to set up quick wins with aggressive creatures. The deck aims to play efficiently and maintain card advantage to pressure the opponent with a mix of cheap threats and evasion creatures. By maintaining control through countering spells and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck can quickly close out games with consistent damage from creatures like Delver of Secrets and Tolarian Terror.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan while utilizing card advantage and card selection. The deck includes a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The win condition is typically through utilizing powerful creatures like Gurmag Angler and Murmuring Mystic, while also applying pressure with unexpected combat tricks. The deck also includes utility lands like Ice Tunnel and Contaminated Aquifer to fix mana and provide additional benefits.

This deck focuses on quickly playing out cheap artifacts and creatures to overwhelm the opponent with a large board presence. By utilizing cards like Thoughtcast and Reverse Engineer to draw more cards, as well as using cheap removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to gain advantages and finish off the opponent quickly. With a mix of efficient creatures like Myr Enforcer and Thraben Inspector, along with enchantments like All That Glitters and Wedding Invitation, this deck can quickly build up a powerful battlefield and pressure the opponent to act quickly.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence and dealing damage to the opponent. Utilizing cheap and efficient creatures like Kor Skyfisher and Monastery Swiftspear, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, the goal is to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game. Cards like Glint Hawk and Thraben Inspector provide card advantage while All That Glitters boosts the power of creatures. The deck also includes artifact lands for additional mana fixing and Barbed Batterfist for a potential finisher. Overall, the strategy is to be fast, aggressive, and consistent in dealing damage.

This deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent through a combination of burn spells and aggressive creatures. By efficiently using cheap burn spells like Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, and Chain Lightning, along with creatures like Firebrand Archer, Thermo-Alchemist, and Monastery Swiftspear, this deck aims to reduce the opponent's life total as quickly as possible. The inclusion of cards like Lava Dart and Reckless Impulse help maintain a fast pace and provide additional reach. Wrenn's Resolve can provide protection for key creatures, ensuring they can continue to deal damage.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly play small creatures like Silhana Ledgewalker and Slippery Bogle, then enchant them with cards like Rancor, Ethereal Armor, and Armadillo Cloak to make them big threats. Utopia Sprawl and Abundant Growth help fix mana, while cards like All That Glitters and Ancestral Mask boost the creatures even more. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful, enchanted creatures and win the game quickly through aggressive plays and increased damage output.

The deck focuses on using various removal spells and creatures with deathtouch to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also incorporates card advantage through sacrificing creatures and drawing cards, as well as generating additional tokens with Khalni Garden and Llanowar Visionary. The combination of Golgari and Jund colors allows for flexibility in removal options and creature choices, while also providing some recursion with cards like Chainer's Edict. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win through attrition and resource management.
